fusions.name: Cached under the Snag
fusions.desc: A weapon strike that deals 24 damage and leaves the target [Pinned] for 3 seconds and [Bleeding] for 4 damage a second for 5 seconds. Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health.

fusions.name: Log Roll
fusions.desc: Rolls your whole trunk over on the spot and deals 28 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles. Every hit is a critical hit.

fusions.name: Mistaken for Driftwood
fusions.desc: You veil yourself for 6 seconds: enemies notice you 70% later. Attacking ends it.

fusions.name: Stillwater Wait
fusions.desc: When your stamina fills, you heal for 25% of the damage you deal for 8 seconds. Once every 24 seconds.
